newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late olein stable, CPO tender cancelled.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late olein stable, CPO tender cancelled.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in quiet late trading on Friday while a crude palm oil tender was cancelled despite a high bid, traders said.
They said the top bid was at 1,195 rupiah/kg, compared with the previous tender price of 1,170 rupiah, but the seller wanted 1,207.50 rupiah.
"The seller felt the bid was not good enough and that he could get a better price exporting it," one trader said.
Traders said palm olein was generally stable in Jakarta at 1,360-65 rupiah but quotes were also heard at 1,370 rupiah.
They said the relatively high bid for crude palm oil showed that some players might be short and this could have an impact on olein prices next week.

"Some players are not covered and the tender has made this evident," one trader said. "I see some upside potential for olein next week." Data from Belawan Port showed that 4,000 tonnes of crude palm oil will leave the North Sumatran port on board the MV Storm Lady on Saturday for Saudi Arabia.
The MT Tirta Gama will leave the port on Friday with 1,900 tonnes of olein for Cirebon while the MT Jappa Dua will leave for Jakarta on Saturday with 1,000 tonnes of olein.
